description: Least-privilege permissions per Wardline feature. All permissions are read-only application permissions. Install-Wardline.ps1, Grant-WardlinePermissions.ps1 and New-WardlineAppRegistrations.ps1 grant exactly the permissions of the selected features – nothing more.

features.name: Endpoint: policies, exclusions, ASR configuration and MDAV baseline from Intune

permissions.why: Intune policies: exclusions, ASR rules, Defender settings (Windows, macOS, Linux)
Display names of the groups policies are assigned to

features.name: Endpoint: device state, local exclusions, effective ASR mode, Linux/macOS drift, local AI agents (Advanced Hunting)

permissions.why: Advanced Hunting queries (DeviceInfo, TVM, DeviceRegistryEvents, DeviceProcessEvents, AgentsInfo)

features.name: Endpoint: allow indicators from Defender for Endpoint

permissions.why: Read custom indicators (allow/block)

features.name: Endpoint: Defender coverage gaps – Intune-managed devices that are not onboarded to Defender for Endpoint

permissions.why: Compare Intune-managed devices with Defender devices (name, OS, Entra device ID, last sync)

features.name: Endpoint: optional device inventory via Intune Remediations (detection script only)

permissions.why: Results of the Wardline detection script
Map Intune devices to Defender devices

features.name: Agents: Entra Agent ID, Agent 365 package catalog and Conditional Access coverage

permissions.why: Agent identity blueprints
Blueprint principals in the tenant
Agent identities and their sponsors
Agent users and sponsors (basic profile only)
Agent 365 package catalog (optional, needs the Agent 365 licence)
Legacy Agent 365 registry (optional, retired from May 2026)
Conditional Access policies and security defaults

features.name: Access: Defender XDR unified RBAC – who holds which role (direct, group, PIM eligible, access package), for which data sources, and whether it was ever used

permissions.why: Defender XDR unified RBAC role definitions and assignments
Entra roles that bypass unified RBAC (Global/Security Administrator, Security Operator/Reader, Global Reader)
PIM for groups: who is eligible for a role-holding group
PIM for groups: when an eligible membership was last activated
Access packages that grant a role-holding group
Sign-ins to the Defender portal – when a permission was last actually used
Resolve role holders of any type (users, groups, service principals)
